text:
sam: Vendor intake arrived from RedTeamInc. They want retest window + evidence handoff schedule. We need a P0/P1 priority list for the retest. Who can own RBAC scope, KMS proofs, and the evidence export? cc @tess @maria

tess: I'll pull the intake doc and scope. Do we want a 2-week retest window? Vendor prefers 3 business days notice before they start. Need a definitive in-scope endpoints list.

maria: For KMS access the vendor will need read-only access to decrypted evidence only. My suggestion: ephemeral roles + presigned S3 objects for artifacts. We should avoid granting broad kms:Decrypt to external principals. @arjun can help with the presigned workflow.

arjun: Proposed technical pattern: create an "AssessorRole" that the vendor can AssumeRole into via STS AssumeRole for a bounded period (max 72h). Permissions: s3:GetObject on pt-evidence bucket, cloudwatch:DescribeLogStreams, logs:GetLogEvents, kms:Decrypt but limited to the evidence key. We'll emit CloudTrail logs for AssumeRole events and export snapshots to a locked bucket. Also add IP restriction + MFA to assume policy.

sam: OK. For RBAC changes we'll add an "assessor" group mapped to the OIDC role; no direct IAM user creds. I'll spin up JIRA board PT-REM for tickets and tag P0/P1.

tess: Compliance asked for raw CloudTrail retention of 90 days. For vendor we can provide filtered exports (anonymize PII). Also need to confirm we can redact prompt text from inference logs before handing over.

maria: Draft commands I'll run to create resources (local dev draft):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name AssessorRole --assume-role-policy-document file://assume.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name AssessorRole --policy-name AssessorS3Policy --policy-document file://assessor-s3-policy.json
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket pt-evidence-ACME --policy file://assessor-bucket-policy.json
```

arjun: Add detection rule in SIEM: alert on AssumeRole by external principal + no-MFA attempts. Also create a daily export job for CloudTrail -> encrypted evidence bucket. Retention snapshot for evidentiary copies: 7 days full snapshot + 90 day raw retention as compliance requires.

sam: Remediation priority matrix I'm proposing:
- P0: auth bypass, KMS exposure, direct data exfil
- P1: privilege escalation, missing audit trails, insecure presigned URLs
- P2: info disclosure low risk, UI issues
Can owners give quick ETAs on fixes for top three items?

tess: Running triage now. Tentative owners: @maria own KMS/key policy changes; @arjun own logging/export and detection; @sam own RBAC docs and evidence packaging. I'll post a 30min sync link.

ops-bot: Reminder: PT kickoff call in 30 minutes — https://meet.link/pt-kickoff :bell:

arjun: One vendor ask: include KV-cache flush events from the inference runtime (they suspect a timing side channel). I'll add that to the evidence list. Need to ensure we redact any user prompt contents.

sam: Agreed — redact prompt text before export. We should include hashes of prompts instead of plaintext for correlation.

tess: I updated the scope doc with the initial in-scope list and the P0/P1 mapping. Posting link in 5. Also creating the first set of JIRA tickets and will tag owners.

maria: After role creation I'll provide the exact assume-role ARN and the presigned object TTL we used for the vendor. Will coordinate the key policy change with security review.

sam: Great. After the call we'll confirm retest slot options: vendor prefers next-week windows Tue/Thu mornings. Let's gather ETA on fixes and lock schedule.

tess: Copy. I'll follow up with a short checklist: 1) Create assessor role + assume policy, 2) Export & redact logs, 3) Provision presigned artifacts, 4) Create JIRA tickets + owner assignment, 5) Schedule retest window.

sam: Thanks everyone. Posting intake doc link in thread once uploaded.
